relationships.subject: menthol
relationships.evidence_quote: The results demonstrated that menthol had a significant effect in relieving abdominal pain in IBS patients.

relationships.subject: capsaicin
relationships.evidence_quote: capsaicin or menthol (agonist of TRPV1 and TRPM8)

key_findings: Meta-analysis of RCTs: menthol significantly relieved abdominal pain in IBS; capsaicin effect was not statistically significant.
Long-term capsaicin studies suggested reduced visceral hypersensitivity, possibly via TRPV1 up-regulation in IBS gut.
